messages.subject: For Jens H. Lund | Global logistics, integration and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Frederiksen,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Jens H. Lund, Group Chief Executive Officer.

DSV's global scale and integration agenda require disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, infrastructure partners, customers and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today in a complex regulated environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional stakeholder matters across corporate and technical teams.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, integration, external affairs and country stakeholder strategy might support DSV's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to DSV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
